title: Geometry-Preserving Nudged Elastic Band and Dimer Methods under Anisotropic Force Uncertainty
summary: The nudged elastic band (NEB) and Dimer methods are standard tools for computing minimum-energy paths and index-one saddle points in atomistic transition problems. They are increasingly driven by surrogate or learned force models, whose force errors are often anisotropic and spatially varying near transition states and defect cores, where saddle-search iterations are most sensitive.
